io.github.luciferyang:cached-fs-spark 0.1.0 发布, Spark soft-affinity scheduling for cached-fs. Drives PROCESS_LOCAL task placement so
    repeat reads of the same file land on the executor whose cached-fs cache likely holds it.
    Combines a static consistent-hash ring (deterministic, no feedback required) with an
    optional duplicate-reading detector (feedback-driven, opt-in) modeled on Apache Gluten.
